headline: New Zealand's S&P/NZX 50 falls 0.3% following late block trade sell-off
summary: The S&P/NZX 50 index fell 0.3% in a late sell-off despite positive corporate earnings, as a $157.4 million block trade in Vital Healthcare units lifted turnover to $361.34 million.
why: The NZX 50 is the benchmark equity index for New Zealand, where large institutional block trades can trigger outsized swings in overall market liquidity.

impacts.name: S&P/NZX 50
impacts.why: Late-session selling and heavy portfolio rebalancing pushed the benchmark down 0.3%.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A $157.4 million block sale in Vital Healthcare units helped drive late-session selling across the NZX 50.
